row.team_price_text: Standard: $10 USD one-time (lifetime licence, 5 instances, 3 panel users)
row.evidence: AMP's edition table offers "Custom Branding and OIDC SSO" on Advanced Edition ($40 USD lifetime) and above; neither the AMP page nor CubeCoders' docs mention SCIM or directory provisioning.
row.notes: Status unchanged (none). AMP is self-hosted game-server panel software sold as one-time lifetime licences per instance count, so per-user prices are null. Standard costs $10 and is no longer shown on the AMP page, which says 'Looking for Standard Edition?'. Professional is $20 on the AMP page but $30 on the editions sheet (see conflicts), and Advanced is $40. Enterprise (for commercial resellers) starts at $20/month. SSO is OIDC only, on Advanced and Enterprise. Users are created on first OIDC login, and IdP groups prefixed AMP_ map to AMP roles. LDAP, which the June row mentioned, is deprecated and being removed. June said OIDC was 'in development'; it shipped in AMP 2.6.1. No SCIM, user-provisioning or IdP-catalogue integration is documented.

user_api.notes: AMP has an HTTP API and plugin API, but no public user-management endpoint reference was found.

entra.notes: No AMP entry in the Microsoft Learn SaaS tutorial index.

fallbacks.notes: OIDC login creates the AMP user (Login.OIDCNewUsersDisabledAtCreation controls whether new users start disabled) and maps AMP_-prefixed IdP groups to AMP roles at each login.
